long: The Floor is Jelly is a puzzle-platformer built around a world where every surface wobbles and ripples like jelly. Players use the elastic, bouncing terrain to navigate atmospheric levels and solve physics-based puzzles. Its distinctive deformable environments and minimalist art give it a dreamlike, experimental feel.
name: The Floor is Jelly
short: The Floor is Jelly (Ian Snyder 2014, Adobe AIR / Windows via Proton)
